integrity: Exact Smith computations and an acyclic-matching certificate are recomputed by the included complete checker. Separate finite-field tests corroborate ranks but do not establish integer torsion.
scientific_limitations: Finite result for the seven-vertex regular cyclic tournament and its C7 rotation quotient; no integral group-ring classification, full homotopy type, or all-order extension is claimed. Independent validation not performed.
title: Seven-primary torsion in the cyclic-tournament multipath rotation quotient
